Control system questions

How do fixed and flexible production modes differ?

Fixed mode follows a stable process and cycle. Flexible mode supports different finishing routes and film thickness requirements with coordinated equipment scheduling.

What should be agreed for MES or ERP integration?

Define the exchanged data, record ownership, supported protocols, network boundaries, error handling and acceptance checks with both system providers.
